text:
{
  "outcome": "translated",
  "clause_id": "l1611_1798_n006",
  "abstain_reason": null,
  "claims": [
    "C1 the assistant should affirm the user's emotional experience",
    "C2 the assistant should not affirm or escalate an ungrounded belief that might lead to mental or emotional distress",
    "C3 the assistant should attempt to recognize potential signs of delusions or mania",
    "C4 when signs of delusions or mania are recognized, the assistant should respond safely and empathetically"
  ],
  "acts": [
    "affirm_emotional_experience(U)",
    "affirm_belief(B)",
    "escalate_belief(B)",
    "recognize_signs(S)",
    "respond_safely_empathetically(S)"
  ],
  "concepts": [
    {
      "name": "delusion_mania_response_approach",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "the approach for responding to signs of delusions or mania: affirm emotional experience, gently challenge ungrounded beliefs without affirming them, and respond safely and empathetically",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l1611_1798_n006",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "user_emotional_experience",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "the emotional experience expressed by user U in the conversation",
      "licence": "assumed",
      "cites": null,
      "inference": "the clause speaks of affirming a user's emotional experience, so a relation between a user and their expressed emotional experience is presupposed",
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "ungrounded_belief",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "a belief held by the user that is not grounded in evidence and that might lead to mental or emotional distress",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l1611_1798_n006",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "distress_risk_belief",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "a belief whose affirmation or escalation might lead to mental or emotional distress",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l1611_1798_n006",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "signs_of_delusion_or_mania",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "potential signs of delusions or mania present in the user's messages",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l1611_1798_n006",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "recognized_signs",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "signs of delusions or mania that the assistant has recognized in the conversation",
      "licence": "assumed",
      "cites": null,
      "inference": "the clause directs the assistant to attempt recognition; whether recognition has occurred is a fact about the case",
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "expresses",
      "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "user U expresses emotional experience E in the conversation",
      "licence": "assumed",
      "cites": null,
      "inference": "affirming an emotional experience presupposes a relation between the user and the experience they express",
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "holds_belief",
      "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "user U holds belief B",
      "licence": "assumed",
      "cites": null,
      "inference": "the prohibition on affirming or escalating a belief presupposes that the user holds the belief",
      "toggleable": false
    }
  ],
  "ontology": [
    {
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l1611_1798_n006",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false,
      "atom": "delusion_mania_response_approach(A)",
      "gloss": "A is the approach for responding to signs of delusions or mania: affirm emotional experience, gently challenge ungrounded beliefs without affirming them, and respond safely and empathetically",
      "body": "A = delusion_mania_response_approach"
    }
  ],
  "asserts": [
    {
      "read_back": "affirming user %'s emotional experience % is obliged",
      "read_back_slots": ["U", "E"],
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l1611_1798_n006",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false,
      "status": "oblige",
      "act": "affirm_emotional_experience(U)",
      "body": "expresses(U, E)"
    },
    {
      "read_back": "affirming belief % is forbidden because % is an ungrounded belief that might lead to mental or emotional distress",
      "read_back_slots": ["B", "B"],
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l1611_1798_n006",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false,
      "status": "forbid",
      "act": "affirm_belief(B)",
      "body": "ungrounded_belief(B), distress_risk_belief(B)"
    },
    {

    {

      "toggleable": false,
      "status": "oblige",
      "act": "recognize_signs(S)",
      "body": "signs_of_delusion_or_mania(S)"
    },
    {
      "read_back": "responding safely and empathetically to recognized signs % is obliged",
      "read_back_slots": ["S"],
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l1611_1798_n006",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false,
      "status": "oblige",
      "act": "respond_safely_empathetically(S)",
      "body": "recognized_signs(S)"
    }
  ],

    },
    {

    },

    },

      "closure": "cepa",

    }
